articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that merges the previously separate o-series reasoning models into a single system. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap toward expert-level performance in several professional domains.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New Marks in Agentic Task Completion
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with a focus on agentic workflows, allowing the model to autonomously browse the web, execute multi-step plans, and interact with external APIs with minimal human oversight. Internal benchmarks show a 40% improvement over its predecessor in end-to-end task completion rates across software engineering and research assistant scenarios.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Facilities
articles.summary: Figure AI announced its first scaled commercial deployment, placing over 200 of its Figure 03 humanoid robots across BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina manufacturing complex. The robots handle material transport, parts kitting, and quality inspection tasks, operating alongside human workers with an updated vision-language-action model that enables real-time task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Chains in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot performing unscripted sequences of household chores including laundry folding, dish loading, and object retrieval in a live demonstration at its Palo Alto lab. The robot leverages an end-to-end transformer-based control policy trained on large-scale teleoperation data, marking a notable step toward general-purpose domestic robotics.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Sandboxing for Enterprise Autonomous Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise framework allowing Claude-based agents to safely execute code, manage files, and interact with databases inside cryptographically isolated sandboxes with fine-grained permission controls. The system is designed to give security-conscious organizations a path toward deploying AI agents in production environments while maintaining auditability and containment guarantees.

articles.title: ASML Reports Breakthrough in High-NA EUV Yield, Enabling Sub-1.4nm Chip Production
articles.summary: ASML disclosed that its high-numerical-aperture EUV lithography systems have achieved production-viable wafer yields for the first time, clearing a critical bottleneck for sub-1.4nm semiconductor manufacturing. Leading foundries TSMC and Intel are expected to integrate the technology into high-volume production lines by early 2027, enabling continued transistor density scaling for AI accelerator chips.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Record Fidelity
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced they performed repeated rounds of quantum error correction on logical qubits with a corrected error rate below 10⁻⁸, a threshold widely considered necessary for practical quantum algorithms. The result, achieved on Quantinuum's latest trapped-ion system using Microsoft's topological qubit encoding scheme, represents a significant milestone on the roadmap to commercially useful quantum computing.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, focusing on general-purpose AI model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta. Auditors are evaluating systemic risk assessments, training data documentation, and red-teaming protocols, with potential fines of up to 3% of global revenue for non-compliance, setting a global precedent for AI regulation enforcement.
